core_research_thesis: Designing an optimal CPU architecture that balances performance, power consumption, and thermal management
proven_facts: Moore's Law dictates transistor density doubles approximately every two years
Shannon's Law limits the maximum rate of error-free data transmission
Boolean Algebra forms the basis of digital logic design
Kirchhoff's Laws govern electrical circuit behavior
Thermal Dynamics Equations describe heat transfer and dissipation
critical_unanswered_unknowns: Optimal CPU architecture for emerging workloads like AI and machine learning
Most efficient instruction set architecture for balancing performance and power consumption
Maximum achievable clock speed given current thermal management technologies

proposed_testable_hypotheses.hypothesis1: Verification through simulation and emulation of CPU architectures

proposed_testable_hypotheses.hypothesis3: Performance and power consumption analysis of different instruction pipelines and caching systems
proposed_testable_hypotheses.hypothesis4: Thermal management optimization through experimental testing of various cooling systems
